article.title: Costs.
article.content: The costs of an application for permission to sue as 4[an indigent person] and of an inquiry into indigency shall be costs in the suit.
article.html:
16Costs.

Order 33, Rule 16

The costs of an application for permission to sue as 4[an indigent person] and of an inquiry into indigency shall be costs in the suit.

4 Subs. by s. 81, ibid., for “pauper” (w.e.f. 1-2-1977).
